A_representation_vs_independent.description: Two otherwise equal candidates: same proposition/different tool vs genuinely independent proposition. Raw tool novelty makes candidate 1 slightly higher.
A_representation_vs_independent.expected: After reconciliation, candidate 1 loses only false novelty reward; candidate 2 can win.

C_same_proposition_fresh_evidence.description: Same proposition with EVIDENCE_NOVELTY / fresh evidence.
C_same_proposition_fresh_evidence.expected: Legitimate evidence value retained; novelty preserved.

F_representation_strong_non_novelty_valu.expected: Remains eligible; may still win; no disqualification or negative penalty.

H_no_negative_novelty.expected: Gated novelty >= 0; never negative penalty for representation redundancy.

I_scientific_evidence_unchanged.description: Candidates with SCIENTIFIC or EVIDENCE novelty.
I_scientific_evidence_unchanged.expected: No global ranking change vs pre-reconciliation baseline.
